mapper.select: select * from daily_plan_item where plan_id = #{planId} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into daily_plan (user_id, plan_date, plan_name, plan_type) values (#{userId}, #{planDate}, #{planName}, #{planType})

insert into daily_plan_item (plan_id, user_id, title, status, planned_minutes, actual_minutes, start_slot, end_slot, sort_order) values (#{planId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{plannedMinutes}, #{actualMinutes}, #{startSlot}, #{endSlot}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select * from weekly_plan_template where user_id = #{userId} order by update_time desc, id desc
select * from weekly_plan_template_item where template_id = #{templateId} order by sort_order asc, id asc
mapper.insert: insert into weekly_plan_template (user_id, template_name, source_plan_name) values (#{userId}, #{templateName}, #{sourcePlanName})

insert into weekly_plan_template_item (template_id, user_id, title, planned_minutes, start_slot, end_slot, sort_order) values (#{templateId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{plannedMinutes}, #{startSlot}, #{endSlot}, #{sortOrder})

insert into annual_plan_segment (user_id, client_entity_id, plan_year, title, start_month, end_month, color_key, sort_order, note, progress_percent, revision) values (#{userId}, #{clientEntityId}, #{planYear}, #{title}, #{startMonth}, #{endMonth}, #{colorKey}, #{sortOrder}, #{note}, #{progressPercent}, #{revision})
mapper.update: update annual_plan_segment set plan_year = #{planYear}, title = #{title}, start_month = #{startMonth}, end_month = #{endMonth}, color_key = #{colorKey}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, note = #{note}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, revision = #{revision} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into annual_plan_segment_subtask (segment_id, user_id, title, detail, status, sort_order) values (#{segmentId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
